text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1934/18 – WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 30, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT
No. 28 of 1964 (CHAPTER 460
Notice under Section 7
Land Mini’s Ref. No.—LD/05/2007/VE/351.

My Ref. No. : Biya 3/1/8/46. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7, of Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 (Amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land to be Acquired:

Two allotments of land in extent of 0.6105 Hectare, depicted as Lot No. 01 and 02 in the Preliminary Plan No. Gam.3955 dated 29.07.2015 prepared by the Superintendent of Surveys-Gampaha District, situated in the village called Ihala Biyanwila in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 269/B of Ihala Biyanwila (Central) in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Biyagama in Gampaha District of the Western Province and more fully described as follows:

1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Gorakagahawatta alias Passionwatta; Description: Home Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mr. D.P.L. Puvimanasinghe, No. 664, Station Road, Wattala; Extent: 0.5293 Hectare.
2. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Could not be traced; Description: Home Garden and open waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.0812 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Biyagama Divisional Secretariat on the 28th October, 2015 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 21st October, 2015 that nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
W.H.V. PUSHPAMALA, Divisional Secretary, Biyagama. Divisional Secretariat, Biyagama, Sapugaskanda, Makola. 10-577
